newsitem.title: USA: Morgan Stanley says Clinton adviser on board.
newsitem.headline: Morgan Stanley says Clinton adviser on board.

text.p: Morgan Stanley Group Inc said Thursday that Laura D'Andrea Tyson, former national economic adviser to President Clinton, has been elected to its board of directors.

Tyson served in the Clinton administration from January 1993 through December 1996. Between February 1995 and December 1996 she served as the president's national economic adviser and was the highest ranking woman in the Clinton White House.
Tyson is also a director of Ameritech Corp, Eastman Kodak Co and the MacArthur Foundation.
